name: gh
description: GitHub CLI suite for github.com and GitHub Enterprise. Full PR workflow: open-pr, push, rebase, review, monitor-pr, worktree, plus raw `gh` commands for issues, checks, and GraphQL. Detects host, fork layout, base branch and PR conventions, and cleans up the worktrees, watchers and temp files it creates. Ships pr-watch.sh (block until CI or feedback needs you) and worktree.py (clone-seeded worktrees with safe remove and prune; a PreToolUse hook seeds Claude Code's own).
